_help: Black market search lines. Fields: {Station} {System} {Where} {Arrival}; the second one uses {Station2} {System2} {Where2}. || splits the line into sentences.
Brain_BlackMarket: Let me look for a black market for you.
BlackMarket_Looking: Looking for the nearest black market. One moment.
Let me find you somewhere a bit shady. Checking now.
Searching for a black market near us, Commander.
BlackMarket_Looking_Sarcastic: A black market. How very legal of you. Searching.
BlackMarket_Looking_Close: Naughty. I like it. Let me find one, love.
BlackMarket_Looking_Frustrated: Fine. Looking for a black market.
BlackMarket_NoSystem: I don't know which system we're in yet. Make a jump and ask me again.
BlackMarket_Disabled: Online searches are switched off. You can turn them on in the Mining page.
BlackMarket_Offline: I couldn't reach Spansh just now. Check your internet and ask me again.
BlackMarket_None: I couldn't find a black market anywhere near us. Try again from another system.
BlackMarket_Found: Closest one I can find is {Station} {Where}.{Arrival}
BlackMarket_Found_Sarcastic: The nearest black market is {Station} {Where}. I never saw you there.{Arrival}
